The '''oovei''' was a type of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] found on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> The oovei birds were [[Color/Legends|colorful]] and would only appear in the [[Standard day/Legends|morning]]. Some Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|females]] had "Oovei" as a given name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The oovei was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
